fieldNameHint: A name you will recognise, for example Orders API.
fieldSpecUrlHint: The link of the swagger.json, openapi.json or openapi.yaml file.
fieldSpecTextHint: JSON or YAML, OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0. Used instead of the link when filled.
fieldBaseUrlHint: Taken from the spec when it has one. Calls are made to this address.
fieldAuth: How the API checks who you are
keepSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
pullsHint: Tick the GET operations NIVO pulls on a schedule. Each one fills one kind of data.
toolsHint: Tick the operations agents may call as tools. Operations that change data always ask you first.
noGets: This spec has no GET operation to show.
needsPath: Needs a value in the path, so it cannot run on a schedule.
tooMany: Showing the first {n}. Search to narrow the list.
itemsPath: Where the list is in the response
itemsPathHint: For example data.items. Leave blank to use the first list found.
scheduleHint: NIVO pulls the ticked operations at this interval.
scheduleNone: No operation is ticked for pulling, so there is nothing to schedule.
schedule_manual: Only when I press Sync now
testHint: Call one GET operation with the settings above. Nothing is saved by the test.
agentTitle: Agents that may use this API
